pr.title: [replay #35846] accounts/keystore: fix race between key scan and delete

patch.s: scanMu   sync.Mutex // serializes directory scans against key file removal

// cache. It cannot interleave with a scan, which could otherwise read the file
// before it is removed and add the account back after it is dropped.
// deleteByFile removes an account referenced by the given path.
